result_identity_aggregation_semantics.count_scope: Every actual cell evaluation where the enclosure representative replaces PRECISION_FLOOR_UNRESOLVED, including transient outer-boundary shooting evaluations and accepted mesh cells.
result_identity_aggregation_semantics.duty_uncertainty_sum: Sum the full U_PROVIDER_DUTY_W once per enclosure event in deterministic evaluation order.
result_identity_aggregation_semantics.hashes: Retain one canonical quantization enclosure hash per event in deterministic evaluation order; no transient event may be omitted.
result_identity_aggregation_semantics.wall_uncertainty_max: Maximum U_PROVIDER_WALL_K over all enclosure events.

existing_roundoff_floor_combination.ambient_decimal_context: Use the existing engineering_context and the repository's existing roundoff-bound recomputation; no caller context inheritance.

fail_closed_conditions: Task172 result invalid or endpoint request/result identity replay fails
Task172 numerical hole, hard blocker, or property/domain blocker
Same-sign residuals or either endpoint already satisfies point-root tolerance
Non-adjacent q or changed provider PH coordinate with any representable binary64 point between
Fluid, phase, profile, correlation/version, applicability branch, topology, support, or wall-interface identity changes
Uncertainty is nonfinite or cannot propagate to existing precision floors

provider_coordinate_exhaustion.comparison: For each coordinate compare exact binary64 endpoints; every changed pair must be adjacent and math.nextafter(left,right)==right; identical pairs are permitted.

representative_endpoint.rule: Choose actual valid Task172 endpoint with minimum abs(F).

projection.scope: Set-valued local cell closure only at an exhausted provider-state binary64 representation boundary; ordinary valid point roots remain unchanged.

trigger_predicates.Q1: Both endpoints are exact VALIDATED Task172 results with no blockers.
trigger_predicates.Q10: Fluid, liquid phase, property profile, provider backend/version/reference state remain identical.
trigger_predicates.Q11: Tube correlation ID/version and shell Bell correlation ID plus candidate-native TASK166 model version remain identical and result-hash bound.
trigger_predicates.Q12: Flow regime and applicability branch remain identical and Pr remains in the existing envelope.
trigger_predicates.Q13: Candidate topology, physical support, tube/shell cells, and wall interface identities remain identical.
trigger_predicates.Q14: No correlation, phase, model, numerical-profile, or applicability branch changes across the endpoints.
trigger_predicates.Q15: Both Task172 request/result identities replay exactly from the actual endpoint evaluations.
trigger_predicates.Q2: Strict valid sign bracket: F(left) < 0 < F(right).
trigger_predicates.Q3: Neither endpoint meets the unchanged abs(F) <= 1e-6 W point-root acceptance.
trigger_predicates.Q4: No Task172 numerical hole is promoted; captured precision-floor diagnostics have zero hole count.
trigger_predicates.Q5: No hard blocker is present; the production failure is only PRECISION_FLOOR_UNRESOLVED and the completed case has zero hard blockers.
trigger_predicates.Q6: No property/domain blocker is present; both endpoints are valid liquid water states within the reviewed domain.
trigger_predicates.Q7: The q endpoints are adjacent binary64 values.
trigger_predicates.Q8: Each differing provider PH enthalpy coordinate is either identical or adjacent binary64.
trigger_predicates.Q9: No representable binary64 provider PH coordinate lies strictly between any changed endpoint pair.

projection.trigger_rule: All Q1-Q15 must be true. Otherwise PROVIDER_QUANTIZATION_ENCLOSURE_NOT_APPLICABLE and retain the existing fail-closed behavior.
